investigation.message: Model 1 (Ridge, trained on real data, test MAE about 77 days) estimates 186 days from first tender to contract signing, with a likely range of 86 to 412 days and an estimated signing date of 2027-06-05. These are model estimates, not recorded facts. Model 1 estimates a 17% probability that the tender runs over 365 days and raises no long-tender alert. The model lists project age at tender as shortening the duration, and the 60-day bid window and Prior review type as lengthening it. This is an estimate. Model 2 gives a simulated contract amendment risk of 38.1%, which places the package on the demonstration review list. This is a model estimate from a model trained on synthetic data, so the records warn synthetic_training_data. It is not validated World Bank risk accuracy. The simulated drivers are procurement category, review type and time since project approval. Model 3 gives a simulated re-bidding risk of 4.7%, assessed as Low relative to the simulated population. This is a model estimate from a model trained on synthetic data, so the records warn synthetic_training_data. It is not validated World Bank risk accuracy. The simulated drivers are procurement method, procurement category and country income group. An Implementation Status Report (ISR 24871317) states that preparation of the bidding document for the works contract, along with the ToR/RFP for works monitoring and other technical assistance, was in progress. It stated a plan to start the procurement process in Q1 of FY16.

Model 1 estimates a 17% probability that the tender runs over 365 days and raises no long-tender alert. The model lists project age at tender as shortening the duration, and the 60-day bid window and Prior review type as lengthening it. This is an estimate.

Model 2 gives a simulated contract amendment risk of 38.1%, which places the package on the demonstration review list. The simulated drivers are procurement category, review type and time since project approval.

Model 3 gives a simulated re-bidding risk of 4.7%, assessed as Low relative to the simulated population. This is a model estimate from a model trained on synthetic data, so the records warn synthetic_training_data. It is not validated World Bank risk accuracy. The simulated drivers are procurement method, procurement category and country income group.

An Implementation Status Report (ISR 24871317) states that preparation of the bidding document for the works contract, along with the ToR/RFP for works monitoring and other technical assistance, was in progress. It stated a plan to start the procurement process in Q1 of FY16.

limitations: All quantitative outputs are model estimates, not recorded outcomes.
Models 2 and 3 were trained on synthetic data and are not validated World Bank risk accuracy.
The ISR passage is dated to the project's early preparation (FY16 plan). It does not confirm the 2026-12-01 tender or the 60-day bid window.
Amendment and re-bidding risks come from models trained on synthetic data; they are not validated World Bank risk estimates.

tasks.question: Predict tender duration, amendment risk and re-bidding risk for a Works package (Request for Bids, Prior review) in project P148850.
What caused delays in the works contracts of project P148850 and what lessons were learned?
